description: Search Secretary of State business-entity registries (official open data) by entity name and/or state entity id. Supported: NY, CO, OR, CT, PA (NY, OR and PA list active entities only; CO and CT include dissolved entities with status). Returns normalized name, entity id, status, type, formation date, jurisdiction, principal/mailing address, registered agent where available, and source URLs. Use for private companies, subsidiaries, LLCs, and verifying legal entity names. Call list_supported_states for coverage and licenses.

entity_id.description: State entity id (NY DOS ID, CO entity id, OR registry number, CT account number, PA filing number). Usually combine with a single state.

name.description: Entity name or fragment, e.g. 'Tiffany and Company'

name: lookup_business_entity
title: State business-entity registry lookup
